commentary.text: 90+8' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+5' Levante can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

90+2' Matias Moreno (Levante) was too forceful with his tackle and Cesar Soto Grado interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
